simple.meaning: Chukkok or Chukok , a place in Palestine
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חֻקֹּק (H2712) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.

definitions.short: Chukkok or Chukok , a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H2712. Chuqoq חוִּקֹק proper name, of a location city in Asher 1Chr 6:60 ᵐ5 Ικακ, ᵐ5 L Ακωκ ; but read probably חָלְקַר ( as Josh 19:25 ) q. v. — חֻקֹ֑קָה 19:34 see below חקק . [ חֻקֹֿק ] proper name, of a location in tribe of Naphtali , only with ה locative חֻקֹֿ֑קָה Josh 19:34 ; identification with Yakûk approximately 4 miles northwest of Lake Tiberias by Rob BR iii. 81 Survey WP i. 365 . חוּקֹק proper name, of a location only 1Chr 6:60 , probably error for חֶלְקַת (q. v.) Josh 19:25 ; 21:31 . חִקֲקֵי see חֹק above
